limitations: Official DOW Documents path for KYCertifiedDWLaboratoryList.pdf returned unavailable (HTTP 404/403) at retrieve time; transcription used Greenup County Health Department mirror PDF with the same title and Revised 4/28/2025 date.

Table lists 16 in-state commercial / independent / regional labs from the PDF. Municipal/utility plant labs and state government labs (KY Division of Laboratory Services KY00033; Environmental Services Branch / Centralized Laboratory Facility KY00041) omitted.
All out-of-state labs (KY9xxxx / KY98026) omitted; use the official DOW list or Greenup mirror.

Certification flags transcribed from PDF columns (Micro/Chem/Crypto/Rads/Asbestos/Dioxin/PFAS/Lead/Fluoride). A blank column means not marked on the PDF — not a claim the lab lacks that capability forever.

Private-well acceptance verified only for HydroAnalytical (well water package) and Western KY Regional Lab / Marshall County Health Department (bacterial testing). All other commercial rows: unknown — call first.

Mail vs drop-off unknown except HydroAnalytical notes sample collection/pickup on its about page. Prices intentionally omitted; Marshall County’s page lists a fee but fees vary by county — confirm locally.
HydroAnalytical PDF mailing address (1906 College Heights Blvd) differs from hydroanalytical.com contact street (2413 Nashville Road, Ste. 100); both shown.

verified_paths.name: HydroAnalytical well water package
verified_paths.notes: Package includes metals suite, anions suite, pH, total coliform, and E. coli. Contact: (270) 745-5287. Lab street from hydroanalytical.com: 2413 Nashville Road, Ste. 100, Bowling Green, KY 42101. PDF mailing address: 1906 College Heights Blvd Bowling Green KY 42101.

verified_paths.name: Western KY Regional Lab / Marshall County Health Department private well bacterial testing
verified_paths.notes: Bacterial analysis (total coliform and E. coli) for private wells/cisterns. Phone on PDF: (270) 252-2702. Address: 267 Slickback Rd Benton KY 42025. Marshall County’s page lists a fee; fees vary by county — confirm locally. No statewide price on this directory.

verified_paths.name: Local health department private-well / cistern bacterial sampling (when offered)
verified_paths.notes: Ask your local county/district health department whether they collect private-well bacterial samples. Example description: Greenup CHD water-testing page. Also see KHDA finder and DOW owner assist.
